A fire broke out at a four-star resort in Bayahibe, Dominican Republic, killing an Italian tourist and forcing over 1,700 guests to evacuate. Officials cite cane roofs and wind as factors.

The Bright Side:
Nearby resorts remained unaffected, allowing for the continued safety of the majority of the displaced guests.

This is a WHERE error. The claim of a 'four-star' resort implies safety standards that were physically absent in the building's construction.
